steps.name: 요청 탭 - 메모 남기기 → 카드 1장 · [더보기] 단추
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-tab="reqs"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const t=document.querySelector('#reqText'); t.value='글머리 기호 세로 가운데 맞춰 줘'; document.querySelector('#reqAdd').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('#tab-reqs .req').length, m=document.querySelector('#reqMore'); return n>=1 && m ? true : 'cards='+n+' more='+!!m

steps.name: [더보기] → 기록 창(편집 화면 위) · 덱은 그대로
steps.js: document.querySelector('#reqMore').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const h=document.querySelector('#reqHist'); const n=h ? h.querySelectorAll('.req').length : -1; const tg=h ? h.querySelectorAll('#rhTg button').length : 0; return h && n>=1 && tg===3 && document.querySelector('#host .rs-slide') && location.hash.startsWith('#tbltest') ? true : 'hist='+!!h+' cards='+n+' toggles='+tg

steps.name: 퍼지 찾기 '글머리기호'(띄어쓰기 없이) → 맞음 · 강조
steps.js: const q=document.querySelector('#reqHist input'); q.value='글머리기호'; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('#reqHist .req').length, mk=document.querySelectorAll('#reqHist mark').length; return n===1 && mk>=1 ? true : 'cards='+n+' marks='+mk

steps.name: 단어 단위 켜면 '글머리기호' 는 안 맞고 '세로' 는 맞음
steps.js: document.querySelector('#reqHist #rhTg button[data-k="word"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const n0=document.querySelectorAll('#reqHist .req').length; const q=document.querySelector('#reqHist input'); q.value='세로'; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const n1=document.querySelectorAll('#reqHist .req').length; document.querySelector('#reqHist #rhTg button[data-k="word"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); return n0===0 && n1===1 ? true : 'word='+n0+' whole='+n1

steps.name: 정규식 '세로|없는말' → 맞음 · 잘못된 정규식은 오류 표시
steps.js: const rx=document.querySelector('#reqHist #rhTg button[data-k="regex"]'); rx.click(); const q=document.querySelector('#reqHist input'); q.value='세로|없는말'; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('#reqHist .req').length; q.value='('; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const err=document.querySelector('#reqHist #rhErr').textContent; rx.click(); return n===1 && err.length>0 ? true : 'alt='+n+' err='+err

steps.name: Esc → 닫힘 · 요청 탭은 그대로 · 토글 상태 저장됨
steps.js: document.querySelector('#reqHist input').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const ls=localStorage.getItem('nexa-search-reqs'); const ok=!document.querySelector('#reqHist') && document.querySelector('#tab-reqs .req') && ls; window.confirm=()=>true; document.querySelector('#tab-reqs .req [data-rdel]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); document.querySelector('[data-tab="props"]').click(); return ok ? true : 'open='+!!document.querySelector('#reqHist')+' ls='+ls
